citation_limitations: INSPIRE counts citations from records covered by INSPIRE; it is not equivalent to Google Scholar, Web of Science, Scopus, or ADS.
impact_proxy_definition: 0.7 * percentile(citation_count) + 0.3 * percentile(citation_count / paper_age_years), computed among records with INSPIRE citation counts.
year_definition: INSPIRE earliest_date for matched records; 2022 inferred only for unmatched external records.
discipline_definition: Official Snowmass Frontier membership plus primary arXiv category/family; multi-frontier papers are counted in each relevant Frontier and fractional_paper_count prevents double-counting in shares.
authors_source: INSPIRE author metadata; proceedings listed-author string used only as fallback.
